instruction: Based on the research study published in PLOS One "Temporal trends in peripartum hysterectomy among individuals with a previous cesarean delivery by race/ethnicity in the United States: A population-based cohort study", of the individuals who had previously given birth via a caesarean delivery, which racial demographic group(s) had more peripartum hysterectomies (per 1000 individuals) in 2018 as compared to 2017? Provide the racial groups as they are named in the study table S1 and list them in alphabetical order.
